gen-almendra-display-gf-lexend-giga: Lexend Giga lays out flat, single-weight lines with generous tracking, so every word gets room to breathe on the page. Almendra Display is the ornate storyteller; the sans just informs.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-sono: Sono stands tall in its lowercase, with wide default spacing between letters. Funnel Display draws spaghetti-like strokes up top, and the two sit together like a loud voice and a steady one.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-stack-sans-notch: Stack Sans Notch reads with open curves you can look right into and a big-bodied feel in every lowercase word. Goldman commands attention with round forms like parentheses; the plain sans simply informs.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-stack-sans-headli: Loud, springy, and wide awake: Grandstander keeps its letters held open, with short ascenders and a tall x-height. Stack Sans Headline follows in a monoline skeleton with wide gaps that stay crisp.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-stack-sans-text: Stack Sans Text draws a marker-like constant line. Gugi stands out with tall lowercase nearly reaching its capitals, while the sans-serif body keeps its curve endings well apart.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-sulphur-: Level, loud, and a bit goofy, Love Ya Like A Sister keeps its ascenders barely clearing the x-height. And Sulphur Point offers a steady, marker-like line with distinct open gaps in c, e, s, and a.
gen-gf-metamorphous-fs-bespoke-sans: Bespoke Sans keeps its curve ends well away from the stem. Metamorphous sets a high midline and soft fat-and-slim strokes for presence, while the sans stays sharp and moderate in height.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-abeezee: Metamorphous puts a high-set midline and a gentle thick to thin shift on display. ABeeZee answers with terminals finishing clear of the stem, so the heading would feel cramped if made small.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-aldrich: Metamorphous carries large sidebearings and modest contrast you notice only on a close look. And Aldrich, with its x-height close to the cap height, reads like tracing one thick thread, round and cupped.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-alexandria: Stately, high-waisted, and softly modulated, Metamorphous takes the lead with large sidebearings all around. Alexandria follows with wide open c terminals and a tall body, its short stems above and below keeping a long read tidy.
